articles.title: Plan Sponsor Expectations and Policy Shifts to Pressure Payers in 2027
articles.summary: Upcoming policy shifts and evolving employer expectations are projected to increase financial and operational pressure on health plan payers by 2027. Self-funded employers are demanding greater transparency, tighter cost management, and alternative pharmacy benefit strategies to curb rising expenses. This environment underscores the need for PBM models that align with employer financial interests and accountability.
articles.source_line: Source: Fierce Healthcare; Fri, 13 Nov 2026 20:00:00 GMT

articles.title: Patients Abandoning Winnable Prior Authorization Denials, Data Shows
articles.summary: A new report highlights how patients frequently abandon prior authorization appeals even when they have a high likelihood of winning, creating hidden barriers to appropriate care. For self-funded employers and PBMs, understanding appeal bottlenecks and friction points is critical for balancing cost containment with employee health access.
articles.source_line: Source: Medical Economics; Fri, 13 Nov 2026 18:28:37 GMT

articles.title: Drug Tariff Pressure Increases Costs for Employer-Sponsored Plans
articles.summary: Rising drug tariff pressures are driving up prescription costs for employer-sponsored health plans. This trend directly impacts self-funded employers by increasing net drug spend and complicating pharmacy benefit cost management strategies. Plan sponsors must evaluate these escalating cost drivers to protect their self-funded benefit budgets.

articles.title: PBMs Face New Legal Pressures for Fee Structure Transparency
articles.summary: Recent legal and regulatory developments are increasing pressure on pharmacy benefit managers to provide greater transparency regarding their fee structures. This shift is critical for self-funded employers seeking to uncover hidden costs and better evaluate the true value of their PBM contracts. The trend toward mandated clarity will likely empower plan sponsors to demand pass-through pricing models and tighter fiduciary accountability.
articles.source_line: Source: Snell & Wilmer; Fri, 13 Nov 2026 23:29:51 GMT

articles.title: DOL PBM Transparency Rule Sparks Debate Over Pharma and Employer Plan Impacts
articles.summary: The Department of Labor's new PBM transparency rule has industry experts divided on its long-term effects on pharmaceutical manufacturers and self-funded employer health plans. For self-funded employers, increased PBM transparency could alter contract structures and pricing visibility, directly impacting plan cost management strategies. The debate centers on how heightened disclosure requirements will ultimately shift financial dynamics across the pharmacy benefits supply chain.
articles.source_line: Source: Healthcare Brew; Fri, 13 Nov 2026 17:09:07 GMT

articles.title: Assessing Optum Rx Profit Growth Amid Falling Prescription Volumes
articles.summary: This financial analysis examines UnitedHealth Group's PBM arm, Optum Rx, and its ability to sustain profit growth despite declining prescription volumes. For self-funded employers and PBM competitors, shifts in major PBM revenue models and volume trends provide critical context on broader market pricing and profitability strategies.

articles.title: Surging Hospital and Drug Costs Drive Fastest Health Insurance Premium Hike in Years
articles.summary: A new report highlights that rising prescription drug and hospital costs are driving health insurance premiums up at the fastest pace since the launch of the ACA. This escalation directly impacts self-funded employers facing heightened healthcare cost trends and underscores the urgent need for aggressive PBM cost-management strategies.
articles.source_line: Source: Washington Times; Fri, 13 Nov 2026 20:40:57 GMT

articles.title: Oral GLP-1 Options Drive Continued Script Growth for Obesity Drugs
articles.summary: The emergence and tracking of oral GLP-1 medications like Foundayo and the oral Wegovy pill indicate continued momentum in obesity drug utilization. This ongoing ascent directly impacts self-funded employers managing specialty pharmacy costs, necessitating strategic decisions regarding formulary inclusion and utilization management for the next generation of weight-loss therapies.
articles.source_line: Source: Fierce Pharma; Fri, 13 Nov 2026 22:12:21 GMT

articles.title: Hims Partners with Eli Lilly for Direct-to-Consumer Weight-Loss Drugs
articles.summary: Digital health platform Hims & Hers has partnered with Eli Lilly to offer FDA-approved weight-loss medications directly to consumers outside traditional employer-sponsored health plans. This trend highlights the growing consumer demand for GLP-1 therapies and introduces alternative access channels that could impact employer benefit plan utilization and cost containment strategies.
articles.source_line: Source: Yahoo Finance; Fri, 13 Nov 2026 15:12:00 GMT

articles.title: CVS Structural Breakup Analyzed as Wall Street Pressure Mounts
articles.summary: Wall Street is increasingly eyeing a potential breakup of CVS Health, separating its pharmacy benefit manager, retail, and insurance units. While such a restructuring may appease investors looking for unlocked value, it is unlikely to satisfy lawmakers and regulators scrutinizing PBM business practices. For self-funded employers, structural shifts at major PBMs could signal major changes in contracting, transparency, and market dynamics.

articles.title: Employer Health Insurance Costs Surge and Threaten Budgets
articles.summary: Employer-sponsored health insurance costs are experiencing significant increases, putting mounting pressure on corporate budgets and employee wage growth. This trend heightens the urgency for self-funded employers to seek aggressive cost-containment strategies, particularly within pharmacy benefits.
articles.source_line: Source: Briefs Finance; Fri, 13 Nov 2026 19:45:00 GMT

articles.title: Rising Healthcare Costs Force Employers to Weigh Premiums Against Pay Raises
articles.summary: Surging healthcare costs are putting intense pressure on employer health plan sponsors, forcing them to choose between increasing employee premiums or limiting wage growth. For self-funded employers, managing escalating pharmacy and medical benefit expenses has become a critical operational challenge directly impacting total compensation strategies.

articles.title: Common Misconceptions Costing Self-Funded Employers Benefit Dollars
articles.summary: An analysis highlights four prevalent misconceptions regarding self-funded health plans that lead to unnecessary employer spending. Addressing these misunderstandings is crucial for optimizing plan design and controlling healthcare costs for self-funded groups.

articles.title: CVS Considers Corporate Breakup Amid PBM Scrutiny and Pressure
articles.summary: CVS Health is reportedly evaluating a massive corporate breakup following intense regulatory criticism and market pressure surrounding its PBM and retail pharmacy operations. This potential restructuring reflects broader industry disruption as traditional vertically integrated PBM models face intense scrutiny from lawmakers, employers, and state-level actions. For self-funded employers, major shifts in legacy PBM business models could signal impending changes to contracting transparency, drug pricing structures, and vendor stability.
